name: MyPadi
description: MyPadi is a general-purpose AI assistant on Telegram. Describe a task in plain language and MyPadi plans the steps, pays for real external data and compute services over x402 on Celo (via buy), checks the results, and returns a sourced report. Users never touch a wallet; the project wallet sponsors usage under strict per-task, per-user and global budget caps.

services.description: Primary user interface. Users send tasks in natural language.
